DicomWeb.// PublicRoot: Orthanc is reached through the backend PACS gateway, never directly. Root is where the plugin is mounted INSIDE Orthanc; PublicRoot is the URL a client is told to come back on. Without it, QIDO responses advertised RetrieveURL as http://host/dicom-web/... which 404s, because the only way in is the proxied path. OHIF was unaffected (its config uses relative roots that resolve under the proxy) but any third-party DICOMweb client following RetrieveURL would fail. Change this together with PACS_PROXY_PUBLIC_URL and the pacs router mount if the proxy path ever moves.
